english:
Requires sprinting for 1.25 seconds. Drains 15% Melee Ability Energy if no enemy is hit. Cannot be used during a slide if you shoot. These rules are shared with other Shoulder Charge Abilities.

Lunges forward 6.8 meters, automatically targeting enemies in range. Guardians directly hit by a Shoulder Charge have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds.

Hitting an enemy deals <pve 878 /> <pvp [90] /> impact damage, applies 40 stacks of <solar Scorch /> plus 20 additional stacks, and deals <pve 586 /> <pvp [60] /> radial damage to enemies up to 7 meters behind the struck target.

Scoring a kill on the directly struck enemy triggers an <solar Ignition />.
